triage.kind_span: Issuer tender offer subject to Rule 13e-4.

price_basis.span: The Offer is for cash at a price equal to the net asset value per Share

price_pct_nav.span: at a price equal to the NAV per Share as of March 31, 2021

nav_pricing_date.span: at a price equal to the NAV per Share as of March 31, 2021

size_shares.span: 9,959,316 Shares (which number represents 5% of the weighted average number of Shares outstanding for the calendar year ended December 31, 2020)

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 4:00 P.M., Eastern Time, on March 30, 2021, unless extended.

proration.span: we will repurchase Shares on a pro rata basis

spans: material legal action or proceeding instituted or threatened which challenges, in the Board’s judgment, the Offer
declaration of a banking moratorium by federal, state or foreign authorities
other event or condition which, in the Board’s judgment, would have a material adverse effect on the Company or its shareholders

trigger_origin.span: We intend to make quarterly repurchase offers for our Shares prior to the occurrence of a liquidity event, if any.

notes: Non-traded interval/tender-offer fund; no ticker printed. Price is NAV per share as of 2021-03-31 (stated as equal to NAV, entered as 100). Size is the lesser of 9,959,316 shares (5% of weighted average shares outstanding for 2020, not of current outstanding; 198,983,536 outstanding at 2021-02-11) and a distribution-reinvestment-proceeds formula, so size_pct_outstanding is left null. Commencement: offer dated 2021-02-22, letter says the offer period begins on or before March 1, 2021; no firm date stated. Conditions: offer is not conditioned on a minimum number of shares tendered.
